title: Machine learning finds a 4-gene plasma signature for hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage
summary: AUCs were 0.94 and 0.89 in independent cohorts for separating ICH from hypertension and from ischemic stroke; PLAU was replicated by RT-qPCR and ELISA, and PLAU inhibition delayed ICH onset in hypertensive mice. Cohort sizes were not read.
ai_technology: LightGBM on a 4-gene plasma panel (ADAM17, TMPRSS5, PLAU, ADAMTS13) with nested cross-validation
organization: Fuwai Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: Independent cohorts, RT-qPCR/ELISA replication, prospective evaluation, mouse model
evidence.unknown: Abstract only; cohort sizes not read; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LightGBM on 4-gene plasma panel (ADAM17, TMPRSS5, PLAU, ADAMTS13)

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
